messages:
meera: getting paged — sudden 429 spike for org=acme, started ~03:44 UTC, low overall traffic though. dashboards show burst drops then immediate 429s.
ops-bot: [alert] rate_limit_spike org=acme 03:44:12 UTC — 429s > 200/min
ryan: looks like this coincides with the console rollout of the new 'smoothing' toggle we shipped last night (flags: quota.smoothing=true). rolling back now?
alex: quick note — the smoothing algorithm maps short-term rate to an effective burst budget. there's a corner when per-key quota is 0 and per-org has tiny burst_window_ms, it can compute negative leftover and clamp to 0 which then flips on next tick. leads to oscillation.
sre-oncall: can you paste the offending logs?
alex: pasting small sample: ```
2026-03-19T03:44:11Z router.go:451 handleReq org=acme key=api_123 status=200 burst_budget=12
2026-03-19T03:44:12Z router.go:451 handleReq org=acme key=api_123 status=429 burst_budget=-1
2026-03-19T03:44:13Z quota_engine.go:223 applySmoothing org=acme old=12 smoothed=-8 clamp=0
```
emily: omg that's the clamp-to-zero flip Alex mentioned — matches metric spikes where burst_budget oscillates between 0 and positive on each evaluation.
dan: did we ship this to prod config only or infra-wide? I thought rollout was limited to prod-console users.
ryan: it was rolled to all regions via config-sync. we gated by percentage=100 due to a bad rollout rule. my bad.
meera: mitigation plan?
alex: short-term: flip quota.smoothing=false via the console feature flag for org=acme and globally for now. medium-term: patch to ensure smoothing never clamps through subtraction — use max(old, min_allowed) and add hysteresis.
sre-oncall: doing the flag flip now. will post when done.
ops-bot: [deploy-bot] featureflag.update quota.smoothing -> false scope=org:all by sre-oncall at 03:46:02 UTC
sre-oncall: flag flipped, monitoring. 429s dropping back to baseline.
meera: good. logging a postmortem ticket: #PM-2345. add action items: stricter rollout gating, unit tests for smoothing edge cases, add metric for effective_burst computed value, improve alerting to include burst_budget histogram.
ryan: I'll own the rollout gating fix and a rollback playbook.
alex: I'll open the PR for the smoothing patch and tests.
emily: also recommend a short-term dashboard tile showing clamp_rate per org so we can catch this earlier.
meera: thanks team. will keep thread open until postmortem is up.
